explanations: ingestDevice calls channel.send() for every frame but collects the promises and only awaits them all at the end. The loop never waits, so it reads the whole device connection as fast as frames arrive. Every reading past the capacity becomes a parked sender inside the channel, and memory grows with the device's send rate instead of being bounded. send() only applies backpressure if the caller waits for it. Awaiting each send before reading the next frame pauses the device connection while the buffer is full, so at most one reading per device is parked beyond the capacity.
